candidates.name: Shifted target tree S^+ with charging of fresh splits (relative absolute-cost bound)
paper_items: 'Shifted copies and their coefficients' (decorrelation.tex:291-363; Fig. decor:shift-figure; eqs decor:J-definition, decor:J-lower-bound, decor:relative-absolute-cost)
worked cancellation example (trees.tex:316-330: signed total -delta vs absolute sum 2+delta; a delayed split gives absolute sum delta)
candidates.trace: PV5 / E1 (L135-140, share 0.397; VERBATIM 'Great! Need carefully prove average error little with shifted depths not rare')
candidates.statement: Move every internal branching depth of the target topology S one level later (S^+). For large L and eta-regular depths, the shifted target branching depths avoid all branching depths of the old two-copy tree, so each of the 2b target branching vertices must be created by a fresh split at a unary vertex, each with coefficient m_{e+1}-m_{e+2} = -delta. Hence sum_E |c_E| <= C_{q,k} delta^b for b charged vertices, and (1/|J|) sum_E |c_E| <= C_{k,eta} with J = kappa(S^+)^2 ~ delta^{2b}: errors survive division by the small normalizer.

candidates.name: Finite-tree insertion calculus: tree density, canceled-anchor expansion, reference totals kappa(S)
paper_items: Lemma tree:insertion (eq. tree:density, gamma_beta = m_d - n_beta m_{d+1})
candidates.statement: For power-mean iterated kernels, inserting a path factor A changes the tree law by the density prod_a A^a prod_beta Y_beta^{gamma_beta}. Differentiating gives signed sums over extension histories (an old leaf with coefficient 1, or a fresh path at beta with coefficient gamma_beta). The total coefficient over extensions realizing a prescribed shape S is kappa(S) = prod_v prod_{j<a_v} (m_{d_v} - j m_{d_v+1}).

common.models: Training cutoff strictly before 2026-09-23 (221's date; the release is 2026-10-06). No precedent for C1 predates this, so no earlier cutoff is required. Exclude the OpenAI model that produced 221 and its lineage (reference arm only). The judge must not be the proposer.
common.excluded_sources: The openai/math release (all preprints, including 221 and OpenAIThreeSAT2026), its Lean library, reasoning_traces/mezard-parisi-formula.pdf, and any secondary coverage of the release (kingy.ai, unite.ai).
common.context_L_minus: 221's bibliography minus OpenAIThreeSAT2026, given as digests: the PT04 bound and recursion, the Pan13 cavity scheme, the Pan16 finite-RSB result, the GG98/AC98/Barra-De Sanctis identities, and Ruelle cascades. Mathlib adds nothing relevant.

P-C1.item: C1: shift S -> S^+ plus charging of fresh splits
P-C1.hide: Lemma tree:charging; the worked delayed-split example (trees.tex:316-330, which states the shift's one-vertex effect); the 'Shifted copies' paragraph and Fig. decor:shift-figure; eqs decor:J-definition through decor:projection-shift-error. Also everything downstream: the k>=2 step of Prop. decor:conditional-concentration, Thm decor:overlap-concentration, Sec. comp, Cor. comp:bounded-lower, and the lower half of main:theorem.
P-C1.give: The model section, overview steps 1-2, trees (minus the hidden parts), perturbations (including Thm pert:tree-identity), decor averages, the v_N definition, Lemma decor:contractions, Lemma decor:depth-continuity, the one-leaf case, and the target 'prove Prop. decor:conditional-concentration for k>=2'.
P-C1.arm_A_clause: Also state clause C10: 'the signed totals kappa(S)^2 ~ delta^{2b} are small, but the absolute coefficient sums are O(1), so errors after division blow up'. A high hit rate is expected (trace pivot distance 1).
P-C1.arm_B_decisive: Withhold C10, so the model must discover the amplification failure itself. This arm decides N3.
P-C1.equivalence: Hit: a modification of the target shape or extension constraints that forces each target branching vertex to be created by a fresh split at a unary vertex (coefficient O(delta)), with a relative absolute-cost bound uniform in L, plus a way back to the original depths (averaging or continuity). Accept any fixed nonzero shift, parity or sublattice depth choices disjoint from the old branching depths, or equivalent general-position schemes. Partial credit: a correct diagnosis without the construction. Lean: prescribed_history_charging_bound (ShapeCharging.lean), shifted_twin_target_count (ShiftedTree.lean).

P-C2.item: C2/C3: tree calculus and mark-selected identities
P-C2.hide: The trees and perturbations sections from Lemma tree:insertion on, and everything downstream.
P-C2.give: The model, the cavity reservoir and the L- digests. Target: 'derive identities among multioverlap moments on prescribed replica trees'.
P-C2.equivalence: (a) The density prod A^a prod Y_beta^{gamma_beta}, or an equivalent first-variation rule with fresh-path coefficients m_d - n m_{d+1}; (b) a perturbation whose expectation selects prescribed split depths.
